name: Last Call at the Break Room
read_aloud: LAST CALL. Snakk-Matic and vendor services close at end of day. Complete purchases now.
narrator_line: LAST CALL. Snakk-Matic and vendor services close at end of day.
layout: The same carpeted saferoom, but the terminal's screen is dimmed and a hand-lettered CLOSING SOON sign has appeared on the fridge.

features.name: The lights flicker as zones close.

quick_run.setup: The Break Room is on its last day of service and CLOSING SOON is taped to the fridge.
quick_run.decision: Buy the terminal key and supplies now, or gamble on the other key routes?
quick_run.on_success: The party leaves stocked and with a key way settled.
quick_run.on_failure: They leave empty-handed and must use the Detour Tax, tools or force at the door.
quick_run.cut_short: Skip the receipts and the corkboard; take only the key and the supplies.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
